bullets_zh: NeuroTechX于2026年9月14日发布MOABB v1.7.2。
该版本修复了TRCA与TRCSP流程中pyRiemann均值API的兼容性问题。
更新增加了TRCSP指标和TRCA协方差处理的回归测试覆盖。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX released MOABB v1.7.2 on 2026-09-14.
It fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs for TRCA and TRCSP workflows.
The update adds regression coverage for TRCSP metrics and TRCA covariance handling.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.2发布，修复pyRiemann兼容性并增强BCI基准测试稳定性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility and strengthens non-invasive BCI benchmarking stability.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

items.title_zh: MOABB v1.7.1 发布
items.title_en: MOABB v1.7.1 Release
bullets_zh: NeuroTechX于2026年8月31日发布MOABB v1.7.1。

该版本在NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常，并保留auto provider回退。
bullets_en: NeuroTechX released MOABB v1.7.1 on 2026-08-31.
It keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through proxy or HTTP failures.
The release catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries and preserves auto provider fallback.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1发布，提升NEMAR不可达时的离线缓存可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 improves offline cached dataset availability when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

The update makes dataset bubble plots reproducible through deterministic layout handling.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0发布，改善离线缓存访问与BCI基准图可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves offline cache access and reproducible BCI benchmark bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

items.raw_excerpt: Pass epochs to SSVEP_itCCA and SSVEP_eCCA in evaluations (#1187) _pipeline_requires_epochs only knew SSVEP_CCA, SSVEP_TRCA and SSVEP_MsetCCA, so an evaluation run with SSVEP_itCCA or SSVEP_eCCA loaded NumPy arrays and the classifier's fit raised "X should be an MNE Epochs object.".
